name: Broad-leaved Helleborine
desc: Broad-leaved Helleborine (Epipactis helleborine): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 16 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Epipactis helleborine, the broad-leaved helleborine, is a terrestrial species of orchid with a broad distribution. It is a long lived herb which varies morphologically with ability to self-pollinate.
